app_introduction: Akhdem Li is your go-to platform for connecting with top-tier service providers in Algeria. Whether you're looking for a plumber, an electrician, a tutor, or a beauty professional, we've got you covered.
mission_description: Our mission is to empower both skilled professionals and clients by providing a seamless, reliable, and secure environment for service exchange. We aim to boost the local economy and simplify daily tasks for everyone.
feature_search: Smart search by location and category
legal_contact_content: If you have any questions about our legal documents, please contact us at support@akhdemli.dz
privacy_section1_content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or communicate with other users.
privacy_section2_content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, including to process transactions and send related information.
privacy_section3_content: We retain your personal data as long as necessary to provide the requested services. In case of an account deletion request, your data is erased from our systems within 30 days.
terms_section1_content: Users are responsible for their own conduct and any content they provide. You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes.
terms_section2_content: Service providers are independent contractors and not employees of Akhdem Li. We do not guarantee the quality of their work.
faq_q1: How do I book a service?
faq_a1: Go to the search tab, find a provider, view their profile, and tap 'Book Now'. Choose your service, date, and time to confirm.
faq_q2: How do I become a provider?
faq_a2: Go to your profile and tap 'Switch to Provider'. You will then be able to create and manage your services.
faq_a3: Yes, we prioritize your security. Your personal data is encrypted and handled according to our privacy policy.
faq_a4: You can reach us through the 'Contact Support' button on the About Us page or by emailing support@akhdemli.dz
